description: Pass vulnerable code as a string and get fix suggestions with before/after patches. Returns structured edit instructions (line numbers, severity, confidence). Use verify_fix afterwards to confirm the fix resolved the issue. Example: fix_code({code: '...', language: 'typescript'})

format.description: Output format: json (for agent auto-fix) or markdown (human review)
